champion.tips: ASHE TIPS AND TRICKS Use your E to scout vision for your team by shooting it diagonally through the enemies jungle. Your team can see what jungle camps have been taken and which ones are still up. You might also spot the enemy Jungler. To initiate team fights, cast your Ultimate R on a target that is isolated or too far forward. Your team can then collapse and focus them down while they’re CC’d. If your lane is even and the enemy has little kill threat on you, once recalled, you could shoot your Arrow R straight through the middle of the map to assist your Mid laner.
champion.builds: THE BEST ASHE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ashe Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, as well as Approach Velocity and Biscuit Delivery in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Kraken Slayer as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Phantom Dancer. For your last 3 items, you should build Infinity Edge, Bloodthirster and finish with Mortal Reminder. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 54.4% winrate over 63 412 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ashe Bot build would be to take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Biscuit Delivery in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Yun Tal Wildarrows, which you should build first, followed by Berserker's Greaves as your second item and Phantom Dancer as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards and Bloodthirster. The skill order for this build is W - Q - E. In the current patch, this build has a 54.2% win rate over 6 892 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Biscuit Delivery in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then Berserker's Greaves as a second item and Phantom Dancer as a third item. You want to finish the build with Infinity Edge, Mortal Reminder and Lord Dominik's Regards. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 54.3% win rate across 1 211 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Ashe Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Press the Attack, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Approach Velocity with Biscuit Delivery as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Kraken Slayer as your first item, then finish Berserker's Greaves as your second item, and Phantom Dancer as third item. The last 3 options are Infinity Edge, Mortal Reminder and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 54.4% win rate over 1 172 matches played. Situational Ashe Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ashe build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ashe runes page.
